description: Browser editor profile. Desktop-heavy projects may use explicit class subsets, authorized by the user. Core semantic projects retain complete production sources.

typesystemIntegration.reason: Real typesystem and non-typesystem editor checkers, diagnostic conversion and highlighting. Desktop checker startup and generated reference-scope checking depend on project-check/generator integrations and are excluded from this browser subset.

editor-runtime.reason: Preserve editor algorithms and omit only the unreferenced desktop image/folder chooser helper. JVM make/workbench startup dependencies are excluded. Declare JDOM directly for editor mementos and selection XML after removing desktop library exports.

intentions-runtime.reason: Preserve intention discovery/execution and omit the standalone desktop settings tree.

findUsages-runtime.reason: Real node-reference, concept-instance and model-usage searches, including traversal fallbacks and registered persistence participants, plus editor model scopes. Desktop FindersManager/plugin discovery remains excluded.

mps-icons.reason: Specific Java companion classes required by the browser editor; desktop module features are excluded.

mps-platform.reason: Specific Java companion classes required by the browser editor; desktop module features are excluded.

mps-ui.reason: Specific Java companion classes required by the browser editor; desktop module features are excluded.

scripts-runtime.reason: Specific Java companion classes required by the browser editor; desktop module features are excluded.

platform.reason: Platform contract only; BrowserPlatform explicitly installs core/typechecking without desktop startup, make, generation or importers.
